resources.string: Measurement, fault and module texts come from your ECU files, in German. Their translations replace them everywhere in the app. Long-press a fault to see its original text.
Files are read from <URL>/<language>/<ecu>.csv. Default: the translations folder of the BimmerData repository on GitHub.
Sent as “Authorization: Bearer …”, for a private repository or your own server.
The folder holds <language>/<ecu>.csv files, or <ecu>.csv files directly.
The ECUs of your car, and every ECU whose texts you open (dashboard, faults, Tool32). A file is downloaded the first time, then works offline.
